name: app-workflow-task-completion
prompt: Deliver the task-completion feature in this existing Flutter fixture, preserving its TaskApi/repository, ChangeNotifier, and injected-controller widget architecture. Completing a task must send its ID once, use the server-confirmed task fields, show a pending state, prevent duplicate submission, preserve the task on failure with a visible recoverable error, support retry, and stop accepting late results after controller disposal. A completed task cannot be submitted again. Inspect the existing code and immutable acceptance tests before editing. Implement the coherent data/state/UI path and add a focused regression under test/regression if useful. Review the final diff and report checks actually executed separately from checks left to the harness. There is no live backend or device target: widget tests with a controlled TaskApi are the available runtime surface. Do not install packages, publish, or fabricate device/backend evidence.
